question: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’. I __didn't saw any__ point in spending money on new clothes.
solution:
The correct answer is **"didn't saw any"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "didn't saw any"** part of the sentence has error.
 
• While making the negative form of simple past tense, we use the rule- **Subject + did + not + Base form (V1) + object**. 
 
 
• **Example:** She did not play well in the ground.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4) ***is the correct alternative.

**The Correct Sentence:** *** **I** ****didn't see any__ **point in spending money on new clothes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let us see the structure of other forms of Simple Past Tense.

 
• 
 
**Positive Form: **Subject + V2 ( Second Form of Verb .

 
 
• 
 
**Example: **We enjoyed the dinner last night.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Interrogative Form: **Did + Subject + V1 ( First Form of Verb) + ?

 
 
• 
 
**Example: **Did we enjoy the dinner last night?

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Negative Form:** Subject + did not + V1 ( First Form of Verb )

 
 
• 
 
**Example: **We did not enjoy the dinner last night.
